briefings.title: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World’s Largest Startup

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: Cisco President and CPO Jeetu Patel explains how he runs Cisco like the world’s largest startup—leveraging a $9.3B AI infrastructure business, pushing 32,000 engineers to embrace AI agents, and scaling hardware and silicon pipelines.

briefings.title: What the AI Boom Looks Like From Inside Cisco with Sam Badri | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 77
briefings.tldr: Sam Badri, Head of Investor Relations at Cisco, explains that Cisco's revenue growth has accelerated from normalized mid-single digits to 15-18%, driven by a booming hyperscaler AI business and a campus refresh cycle.

briefings.title: Cisco Q3FY26 Earnings Conference Call
briefings.tldr: Cisco delivered record Q3 results with 12% revenue growth and a 35% surge in product orders, driven by an massive acceleration in AI infrastructure demand.

briefings.title: Cisco CEO Chuck Robbins wants data centers in space | Decoder
briefings.tldr: Cisco CEO Chuck Robbins asserts that the company is pivoting to meet "insatiable" AI demand through custom silicon and integrated security, while predicting that data centers will eventually move into space to bypass terrestrial power and political constraints.

briefings.title: AI Is Writing the Code Now: Cisco’s Vision for the Agent Era

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: EVP and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: Cisco is transitioning to an "Agent Era" where AI acts as an autonomous co-worker rather than just a tool, with plans to have 60–70% of its entire product portfolio written by AI by the end of 2027.

briefings.title: LIVE: Cisco CEO Addresses India AI Impact Summit 2026
briefings.tldr: Cisco CEO Jeetu Patel asserts that the global AI transition requires a fundamental shift from document-based governance to runtime security, positioning India as a central hub for this evolution due to its massive scale, digital foundation, and young talent pool.

briefings.title: Cisco Live 2026 Amsterdam: Opening Keynote | What's Next, Starts Now

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: EVP and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: Cisco is positioning itself as the "critical infrastructure for the AI era," transitioning from simple productivity chatbots to a future of autonomous "AI agents" through a platform-first strategy that integrates networking, security, and observability.

briefings.title: 3D & AI | Dr. Fei-Fei Li, CEO & Co-Founder, World Labs & Jeetu Patel

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: Dr. Fei-Fei Li, CEO & Co-Founder of World Labs, asserts that spatial intelligence – the ability for AI to understand and interact with the 3D/4D physical world – is the next critical frontier for AI, unlocking advanced applications beyond current language models.

briefings.title: Cloud & AI | Matt Garman, CEO, AWS & Jeetu Patel

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: Companies often fail to transition AI from proof-of-concept to production due to undefined success metrics and scaling challenges, while AWS is building a natively integrated "AI-first cloud" platform, including proprietary silicon, to address these issues and emerging sovereign AI requirements.

briefings.title: Frontier Models & AI | Sam Altman, CEO & Co-Founder, OpenAI and Jeetu Patel.

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: AI models like Codex and OpenClaw are ushering in a "ChatGPT moment" for knowledge work and software development, but their widespread adoption is challenged by the need for new security paradigms, redesigned software, and faster enterprise absorption, demanding significant infrastructure investment and a shift to thinking about AI as a collaborator, not just a tool.

briefings.title: Silicon & AI | Lip-Bu Tan, CEO, Intel & Jeetu Patel

people.name: Jeetu Patel
people.role: Executive Vice President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco

briefings.tldr: Intel is aggressively pivoting toward a dual-track strategy as both a premier product innovator and a general-purpose foundry, aiming to overcome critical AI infrastructure bottlenecks in memory, cooling, and interconnects while racing to maintain a lead over rapidly advancing Chinese competition.

briefings.title: Venture & AI | Marc Andreessen, Andreessen Horowitz & Jeetu Patel
briefings.tldr: Marc Andreessen believes AI holds "absolutely incredible" potential to reverse decades of productivity stagnation, but its transformative impact will be shaped by ongoing regulatory challenges, the fierce geopolitical competition between the US and China, and the disruptive force of open-source models.

briefings.title: Silicon & AI | Jeetu Patel & Lip-Bu Tan, CEO, Intel
briefings.tldr: Lip-Bu Tan, CEO of Intel, outlines Intel's strategic turnaround, emphasizing its commitment to becoming a leading, general-purpose foundry and addressing critical AI infrastructure bottlenecks, while urging significant investment in US foundational research and open-source development to counter escalating global competition.

briefings.title: Cisco AI Summit | Special live event with Jensen Huang
briefings.tldr: AI fundamentally reinvents computing by shifting from explicit to implicit programming, driving the need for enterprises to adopt an "AI factory" mindset, strategically experimenting with the technology, and transforming into "technology-first" companies to leverage AI's exponential capabilities and avoid being left behind.

briefings.title: Cloud & AI | Jeetu Patel & Matt Garman, CEO, AWS
briefings.tldr: AWS CEO Matt Garman emphasizes that successful AI adoption hinges on clear success metrics, robust security frameworks, and scalable infrastructure, detailing AWS's "AI-first cloud" vision, custom silicon, and sovereign cloud solutions designed to enable rapid and secure enterprise deployment.
